services.title: Access Arrangements Testing
services.summary: Formal assessment of students who may require additional support during exams due to specific learning difficulties or disabilities. £60 per pupil.
services.details:
• Completion of Part 1 of Form 8 is required prior to the assessment
  • A thorough evaluation of the student's needs.
  • Completion of Part 2 of Form 8 by assessor.

services.title: Adult Support
services.summary: Support for individuals studying at a higher level or in the workplace. £60 per hour or 6 hours block booked at £300.
services.details:
• Areas of targeted support agreed beforehand such as; study skills, organisation, and planning time.
  • Emotional and mental wellbeing support available through the sessions and where it arises.

services.title: Speech and Language Therapy
services.summary: Following on from a SALT assessment, we offer school aged children 6 x direct therapy sessions of 50 minutes, goal setting and review along with a short written summary with advice on next steps. £700.
services.details:
• 6 in-person therapy sessions
  • Goal setting and review
  • Short written summary with advice on best next steps

services.title: Bespoke Teaching Packages for EOTAS Pupils
services.summary: 1:1 and small group provision for EOTAS pupils. Price are available on request.
services.details: • Please contact Becky Johnson for further information at becky@newts.uk.

services.title: Development Training
services.summary: Staff training via Zoom or in person with Ellie. £150 per hour.
services.details: • Range of SEND and development related subjects.

services.title: Developmental Interventions
services.summary: Tailored developmental interventions carried out 1:1 as a half day. £150.
services.details:
• Initial in person assessment and discussion with staff/family
  • Block of planned developmental play sessions
  • End of unit report

services.title: Early Years Development Play Assessment
services.summary: Early years development assessment lasting 4-5 hrs. £230.
services.details:
• Discussion with family or setting staff, and observation time if at an Early Years setting
  • In person play and interaction based assessment
  • Mid length report, feedback and advice

services.title: Family and School Support
services.summary: Guidance and recommendations for families and school staff.
services.details:
• Sometimes support can come in the form of guidance and recommendations to the family/carers and staff supporting the individual in their journey.
  • Some examples include study skills, home routines to help improve home-life, and training in specific areas of need.

services.title: Setting up as a Practitioner
services.summary: Support in setting up your own business, either as a sole trader or limited company. 1-hour face to face meeting with email support for 3 months. £60.
services.details:
• Invoicing
  • Accounting records
  • Terms and Conditions
  • Privacy Notice
  • £60

services.title: Foundation Stage Project
services.summary: Foundation stage project reception year. 13-14 hours. £700.
services.details:
• Meeting with staff to plan via zoom
  • Two mornings on site with staff carrying out whole cohort play based assessment
  • Detailed long report
  • Follow up meeting to support planning for cohort development key needs
  • Two twilight trainings on topics related to key needs

services.title: Developmental Language Disorder
services.summary: Following a full diagnostic assessment, we offer a Developmental Language Disorder (DLD) direct assessment with a qualified speech and language therapist. £450.
services.details:
• DLD full assessment by a qualified Speech and Language Therapist
  • Written feedback and personalised recommendations
  • £450

services.title: Full Developmental Assessment
services.summary: A full developmental assessment for year 1 onwards. 5-6 hour assessment with a detailed report. £270.
services.details:
• Preliminary conversation with family and/or school staff
  • In person developmental assessment
  • Long written report, feedback and advice

services.title: SENCO Consultation
services.summary: Up to one hour meeting with a fully qualified speech and language therapist. £100.
services.details:
• SaLT queries around universal or targeted provisions in school
  • Recommendations
  • Advice
  • Problem-solving

services.title: Full Diagnostic Dyslexia Assessment
services.summary: A face-to-face assessment followed by a substantial written report. Age 8 upwards. £550.
services.details:
• Approximately 3 hours, this can only be completed on individuals age 8 and over.
  • Assessment consists of standardised assessments which reflect strengths and challenges across underlying ability and cognitive processing abilities.
  • Assessment of attainment in the areas of reading, spelling, and writing.
  • Detailed diagnostic written report, including recommendations and any considerations for exam access arrangements.
  • This report will travel with the individual for life as I hold an APC.
  • For 18 years + we are able to identify characteristics of ADHD as part of a full diagnostic assessment. This involves an additional 2-hour interview at a cost of £120.

services.title: Full Speech and Language Assessment
services.summary: A full speech and language assessment for children and adults lasting up to 6 hours. £450.
services.details:
• An initial discussion with parents/carers and school staff
  • Liaison with relevant professionals, if appropriate
  • A comprehensive assessment of speech, language and communication skills
  • Observations of communcation in everyday activities and play
  • Interpretation of assessment findings
  • A clear, detailed written report
  • Feeback with practical, personalised recommendations

services.title: Pupil Observation
services.summary: In class pupil focused observation. £60.
services.details:
• Focus to be decided prior to observation.
  • Up to one hour observation in class.
  • Includes verbal feedback.
  • Optionally, written feedback can be provided for an additional charge.

services.title: Resilience Coaching
services.summary: Curriculum led education and wellness experience for 9- to 18-year-olds with Steph.
services.details:
• In small groups or 1:1, children and adolescents aged 9 to 18 will learn through experiential activities, videos, games and dynamic exercises, which take place over 11 interactive sessions.
  • Resilience coaching will empower your child to deal with issues such as self-esteem and labels, using social media, hostile behaviour of others, and disagreements and conflicts.
  • The Resilience Tutoring package includes the Creating a Resilient Family course for parents.
  • Resilience and wellbeing training gives your child the confidence to manage feelings and overcome difficulties.
  • Past participants have reported less anxiety, worry, fear and reactive behaviour and improved relationships with parents, siblings and peers.

services.title: Small Group SEND Observation
services.summary: Observation and advice for small group of early years children with SEND and developmental needs. 2.5-3 hour session. £150 per child.
services.details:
• Observation, discussion with staff and play with identified children at setting with parental permission
  • Verbal advice
  • Short report and suggested next steps and activities

services.title: Small Space for Hire
services.summary: Please get in touch if you are looking for a space for individual talking therapies or for groups of up to 8 people. Price available on request.
services.details:
• We have a small space available for hire in Strixton, Northamptonshire.
  • Suitable for individual talking therapies or small groups of up to 8 people.
  • Price available on request.

services.title: Spotlight Assessment
services.summary: A face-to-face assessment followed by a short report. NB This assessment will not diagnose dyslexia. £300.
services.details:
• Approximately 1.5 hours, this can be completed on children from age 6+
  • Bespoke Spotlight will cover standardised test of underlying ability and one further area of cognitive processing; such as phonological processing or working memory. A word reading and word spelling test will also be administered.
  • Detailed short written report, including recommendations.
  • Can be accompanied by a pupil focussed observation in class, for an additional fee.

services.title: Training
services.summary: Bespoke training can be arranged on request. Usually we cover executive function skills, dyslexia and neurodiversity.
services.details:
• Schools. In school training for SENCOs, Teachers or Teaching Assistants.
  • Parents. Online or small face-to-face group training available.

services.title: Specialist Teaching for Children with SEND
services.summary: 1:1 and small group specialist teaching for children with SEND. £60 per hour or £300 for a block of 6 hours.
services.details:
• Some individuals may benefit from specialist teaching to support their learning and development. This can be delivered at the Strixton centre.
  • Specialist teaching can focus on areas such as literacy, numeracy, executive function skills, social skills, and emotional regulation.
  • Sessions are tailored to the individual's needs and learning style.
  • Progress is regularly reviewed and feedback is provided to parents and carers.
  • Six week blocks are available at a discounted rate.

services.title: Workplace Needs Assessments
services.summary: Specialist evaluation of the employees' working environment, and tasks to identify adjustments needed. These assessments help employers fulfil their legal obligations under The Equality Act 2010, and promote a more inclusive and productive workplace. £540.
services.details:
• The primary goal is to identify reasonable adjustments, accommodations, or assistive technologies that enable the employee to perform their job duties effective and safely.
  • Suitable for individuals with a range of neurodiverse conditions.
  • Involves conducting a 1:1 interview with the employee and employer.
  • The assessment results in a report with detailed recommendations for adjustments tailored to the individual's needs and workplace context.

services.title: Drawing and Talking
services.summary: A therapeutic intervention using drawing and talking techniques for children and young people.
services.details:
• Initial chat and getting to know you session – 30-60 mins
  • 12 weeks, 1-hour sessions
  • Drawing & Talking for Year 2 upwards
  • Sand-play EYFS and under

services.title: Zones of Regulation
services.summary: A programme to teach emotional literacy and self-regulation strategies.
services.details:
• Initial chat and getting to know you session – 30-60 mins
  • Approximately 12 weeks, 1-hour sessions
  • Programme to teach emotional literacy and strategies.
  • Supporting families and carers to implement the programme at home to reinforce learning and progress.

services.title: Lego-based Therapy
services.summary: A programme designed to support children with social communication difficulties.
services.details:
• Initial chat and getting to know you session – 30-60 mins
  • Approximately 8-12 weeks, 1-hour sessions
  • Programme is designed to support children with social communication difficulties. It encourages turn taking, sharing, listening, team-work and problem solving.
  • Parents/carers or an additional sibling can be involved in the course if required (at no additional cost).

services.title: Emotional Support
services.summary: Targeted interventions to support children's emotional wellbeing, including self-esteem, resilience, anxiety, anger and bereavement.
services.details:
• Initial chat and getting to know you session – 30-60 mins
  • Approximately 12 weeks, 1-hour sessions
  • Sessions can support: self-esteem and resilience, social skills, anxiety, anger, and bereavement.
  • Supporting families and carers to implement the programme at home to reinforce learning and progress.
  • This support can be delivered through a range of targeted interventions, including: The Hidden Chimp, Starving the Anger Gremlin CBT, Starving the Anxiety Gremlin CBT, and Stop, Think, Do.

services.title: Maths and English Tutoring
services.summary: Tutoring in maths and English for primary age children.
services.details:
• Initial chat and getting to know you session – 30-60 mins
  • Primary age only
  • Supporting families and carers to implement the programme at home to reinforce learning and progress.

services.title: Hypnotherapy, NLP and EMDR
services.summary: Therapeutic support using hypnotherapy, neuro-linguistic programming (NLP) and eye movement desensitisation and reprocessing (EMDR) techniques.
services.details:
• Initial chat and getting to know you session - 30- 60 mins.
  • A combination of Hypnotherapy, NLP and EMDR can be used in a session based on individual needs. Helps with fears, phobias, anger, anxiety, confidence, depression, trauma and other issues that have an impact on daily life.
  • Supports positive changes and emotional regulation, teaches practical strategies to use outside sessions.
  • Addresses subconcious patterns to reshape thinking and behaviour.
  • Sessions are also available for adults.

services.title: Developmental Coordination Disorder questionnaire - child
services.summary: As part of a full diagnostic assessment we offer a DCD questionnaire which will focus on early motor skill difficulties. £60.
services.details:

  • Suitable for ages up to 16 years old
  • Not a diagnosis
  • £60

services.details:

  • Will support onward referral
  • Not a diagnosis
  • £120

services.title: Developmental Coordination Disorder Interview - adult
services.summary: As part of a Full Diagnostic Dyslexia Assessment, we offer a DCD interview which will focus on early motor skill difficulties and identify characteristics associated with DCD. £120.
services.details:
• Support onward referral
  • Suitable for ages 16+
  • Not a diagnosis
  • £120

services.title: ADHD Child Evaluation
services.summary: Following a Full Diagnostic Dyslexia Assessment or a spotlight assessment, we offer an additional interview which can help highlight the core characteristics of ADHD. £120.
services.details:
• Available for ages 5-17 years
  • Will support onward referral
  • Not a diagnosis of ADHD
